== Title ==
<span lang="ja">後でも構いません</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">相手がカードを配備した直後に使用する。３フォース消費してそのカードを相手の手札に戻させる。そのカードを配備するのに消費したフォースは消費されたままとなる。次の相手のターンに、そのカードは不可能でない限り、必ず同じロケーションに配備されなければならない。この際、配備にフォースは消費しない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「ソロ船長。お伝えしておいた方が……いいえ、後でも構いません」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[It Can Wait]].

'''Lore''' — “Captain Solo. I should tell you—no, it can wait.”

'''Game text''' — Use after the opponent just deployed a card. Spend 3 Force to return that card to the opponent’s hand. Force spent to deploy it remains used. On the opponent’s next turn, that card must be deployed to the same location if possible. Deploying it then costs no Force.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese lore names Captain Solo and completes the line; English lore is abbreviated. Game text follows the original printed location wording, not the later Immediate Effect / same-target errata.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-itcanwait-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[It Can Wait]].</ref>
